title.zh: 悠青嘉 · 电壶转化与失衡连斩
title.en: Harumasa / Qingyi / Astra · Quivers into Stun-window slashes

summary.zh: 依据原作者与固定技能整理的条件式教学：青衣准备失衡，嘉音维持支援，悠真按真实电囚连斩；不是逐帧或最高分实测轴。
summary.en: Conditional teaching assembled from original authors and fixed skills: Qingyi prepares Stun, Astra supports, Harumasa spends actual Electro Prison. Not a frame-tested or highest-score rotation.

conditions.zh: 循环站位嘉音→悠真→青衣；嘉音Q替换连携与快支均按真实方向和提示。
conditions.en: Use Astra → Harumasa → Qingyi cyclically; actual prompts and direction govern assists and converted Chains.

conditions.zh: 0影无专武可用；青衣满足悠真击破队友条件，悠真满足青衣强攻与嘉音强攻队友条件。
conditions.en: Executable at M0 without signatures: Qingyi satisfies Harumasa’s Stun condition; Harumasa satisfies Qingyi and Astra’s Attack conditions.

conditions.zh: 嘉音驻唱与加攻分开核对；25能量不足不假定加攻。每段独立按当前资源进入，不机械重复连携。
conditions.en: Check Cadenza and entry ATK separately; no assumed ATK below 25 energy. Enter each phase from actual resources rather than repeating Chains mechanically.

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 开唱并让青衣进入有效击破循环
objective.en: Establish Cadenza and Qingyi’s Daze loop

title.en: Start singing and confirm Quick Assist

input.zh: 点按特殊技，命中后按悠真的快支提示。
input.en: Press Special; after it hits, follow Harumasa’s Quick Assist prompt.

trigger.zh: 咏叹华彩尚未开启；有可命中的目标。
trigger.en: Idyllic Cadenza is inactive and a target can be hit.

complete.zh: 状态开启且实际命中；快支提示出现才交给悠真。
complete.en: Cadenza starts and the attack hits; hand over only when the assist prompt appears.

reason.zh: 先建立持续支援环境；不能把开唱直接当作全队加攻。
reason.en: Set up sustained support without assuming singing grants everyone ATK.

fallback.zh: 未命中则重新找目标；没25能量仍可开唱，但不计本次加攻。
fallback.en: Retarget after a miss. Singing can start below 25 energy, but this entry grants no assumed ATK.

signal.zh: 特殊技命中，悠真快支提示亮起。
signal.en: Special hits and Harumasa’s Quick Assist prompt appears.

input.zh: 按实际快支提示切悠真，完成穿弦。
input.en: Use the actual assist prompt to enter with Harumasa and finish Bowstring.

trigger.zh: 嘉音→悠真→青衣的循环站位，且提示确实指向悠真。
trigger.en: Use Astra → Harumasa → Qingyi cyclically; the prompt must actually select Harumasa.

complete.zh: 快支完成；若嘉音消耗25能量追加震音，再确认悠真加攻。
complete.en: Finish the assist; confirm Harumasa’s ATK only if Astra actually spends 25 energy for Tremolo.

reason.zh: 普通换人不能代替该条件；快支也不直接制造电壶。
reason.en: An ordinary switch cannot replace this condition, and Quick Assist does not create Quivers.

fallback.zh: 无提示就不假装快支；正常切人后按现有状态继续，未取得加攻时再安排合格入场。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally and use actual states; obtain a later qualifying entry if ATK is missing.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

title.en: Use Qingyi EX to reach Basic 3

input.zh: 普通切青衣；有能量时点按强化特殊技，之后接普攻。
input.en: Switch normally to Qingyi; use EX when available, then Basic.

trigger.zh: 目标未失衡，青衣有EX能量；已有第三段可直接跳过EX。
trigger.en: Target is not Stunned and EX energy is sufficient; skip EX if already on Basic 3.

complete.zh: EX完成后接上第三段，不因普通入场计嘉音加攻。
complete.en: Connect Basic 3 after EX; do not credit Astra ATK for this ordinary entry.

reason.zh: EX提供可控的第三段入口，之后由实际电压决定重击。
reason.en: EX provides a controlled Basic-3 entry; actual Voltage determines the charged attack.

fallback.zh: 能量不够就从常规普攻打至第三段；防御优先，不强按空EX。
fallback.en: Without energy, reach Basic 3 through normal Basics; defend rather than forcing an unavailable EX.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

input.zh: 第三段持续点按普攻；有攻击先闪避，再按实际连段继续。
input.en: Keep tapping Basic during stage 3; dodge attacks and continue from the actual combo state.

trigger.zh: 电压尚未到75%，或需要继续积累失衡。
trigger.en: Voltage is below 75%, or further Daze is needed.

complete.zh: 观察闪络电压达到75%以上，准备长按；不要为每个快支提示中断。
complete.en: At 75%+ Voltage prepare the hold; do not interrupt for every assist prompt.

reason.zh: 电压和目标失衡是两条不同进度；固定次数不能保证失衡。
reason.en: Voltage and enemy Daze are separate gauges; a fixed hit count cannot guarantee Stun.

fallback.zh: 被打断就重新接第三段；敌人提前失衡时转爆发，未叠满羁服如实处理。
fallback.en: After interruption reconnect Basic 3. If Stun occurs early, use the window without assuming maximum Subjugation.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

input.zh: 闪络状态长按普攻，完成突进和终结一击；遇攻击可择机松手防御。
input.en: In Flash Connect, hold Basic through the lunges and finisher; release defensively when needed.

trigger.zh: 实际电压≥75%，且有机会让招式命中。
trigger.en: Actual Voltage is at least 75%, with a hittable target.

complete.zh: 确认终结一击命中和羁服实际层数，再按真实失衡/连携状态交棒。
complete.en: Verify the finisher hit and actual Subjugation stacks, then follow real Stun and Chain states.

reason.zh: 提前松开会提前终结；完成一次不等于必然满层或打出失衡。
reason.en: Early release triggers an early finisher; one sequence does not guarantee maximum stacks or Stun.

fallback.zh: 未失衡继续青衣准备；失衡已出现则停止凑固定轮数，检查悠真的爆发入口。
fallback.en: If not Stunned, continue setup. If Stun occurs, stop forcing fixed repetitions and check Harumasa’s entry.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

prep.zh: 悠真快支完成后普通切青衣；已有满电压时可直接长按分支。
prep.en: After Harumasa’s assist, switch normally to Qingyi; with full Voltage already available, use the hold directly.

label.zh: 常态与转爆发
label.en: Loop into burst

objective.zh: 用真实失衡和入场条件接上悠真
objective.en: Enter Harumasa through real Stun and assist conditions

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

title.zh: 可选：嘉音终结技提供转换连携
title.en: Optional: Astra Ultimate enables converted Chains

input.zh: 嘉音自己的终结技已就绪且需要转换入口时发动，命中后选择悠真提示。
input.en: Use Astra’s own ready Ultimate if a converted entry is needed; follow Harumasa’s prompt after impact.

trigger.zh: 嘉音喧响就绪；剩余窗口值得使用，没有必要补时可跳过。
trigger.en: Astra’s Decibels are ready and the remaining window justifies it; otherwise skip.

complete.zh: 确认下两次快支转换已获得；按当前提示接悠真，不自动消耗两次给同一角色。
complete.en: Confirm the two shared Quick-to-Chain replacements; follow the current prompt, without assigning both to one agent.

reason.zh: 转换连携仍有站位方向，不能当作随意选人的敌人连携。
reason.en: Converted Chains retain assist direction; they are not unrestricted enemy-triggered Chain choices.

fallback.zh: Q未好则跳过，使用真实敌人连携；无连携可用时，悠真有能量则EX造壶进入爆发。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable and use a real enemy Chain; if no Chain exists, Harumasa can create Quivers with an available EX.

signal.zh: Q实际命中，面板给出指向悠真的替换连携。
signal.en: Ultimate actually hits and the converted Chain prompt points to Harumasa.

input.zh: 实际连携提示可选悠真时确认；让箭命中敌人或地面。
input.en: Select Harumasa from a real Chain prompt and let the arrow hit the enemy or ground.

trigger.zh: 敌人连携可选悠真，或嘉音Q后的实际替换连携指向悠真。
trigger.en: An enemy Chain offers Harumasa, or Astra’s actual converted Chain points to him.

complete.zh: 场上电壶已出现；同时核对嘉音是否实际花25能量给予入场加攻。
complete.en: Verify Quivers on the field, and whether Astra actually spent 25 energy to grant entry ATK.

reason.zh: 连携生成6壶并强化下一次普攻第五段的产壶；壶尚不等于电囚。
reason.en: Chain creates six Quivers and improves the next Basic-5 generation; Quivers are not Electro Prison yet.

fallback.zh: 无连携提示不强行执行；有EX能量时以EX造6壶代替本步，否则回青衣准备。
fallback.en: Do not force a missing Chain. With energy, substitute EX to create six Quivers; otherwise return to Qingyi setup.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

prep.zh: 嘉音状态仍在就不反复开唱；Q是可选入口，不要求每轮都好。
prep.en: Do not restart active Cadenza; Astra Ultimate is optional and need not be ready every loop.

prep.zh: 本段末尾已完成悠真连携，接爆发段时从落羽开始；不重复放连携。
prep.en: If this phase ended with Harumasa’s Chain, begin the burst at Falling Feather; do not cast Chain twice.

label.zh: 失衡爆发
label.en: Stun burst

objective.zh: 造壶→落羽→连斩，窗口结束回青衣
objective.en: Quivers → Falling Feather → slashes, then return to Qingyi

input.zh: 实际连携提示可选悠真时确认；让箭命中敌人或地面。
input.en: Select Harumasa from a real Chain prompt and let the arrow hit the enemy or ground.

trigger.zh: 敌人连携可选悠真，或嘉音Q后的实际替换连携指向悠真。
trigger.en: An enemy Chain offers Harumasa, or Astra’s actual converted Chain points to him.

complete.zh: 场上电壶已出现；同时核对嘉音是否实际花25能量给予入场加攻。
complete.en: Verify Quivers on the field, and whether Astra actually spent 25 energy to grant entry ATK.

reason.zh: 连携生成6壶并强化下一次普攻第五段的产壶；壶尚不等于电囚。

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

input.zh: 刚完成连携、EX或普攻第五段时长按特殊技；也可长按普攻瞄准后松开。
input.en: After Chain, EX or Basic 5, hold Special; alternatively hold Basic to aim, then release.

trigger.zh: 场上有电壶，且能瞄准当前爆发目标。
trigger.en: Quivers exist and the intended target can be aimed at.

complete.zh: 落羽与甲乙矢实际命中，观察十文字；失衡/异常目标的额外2层也要落羽命中。
complete.en: Verify Falling Feather and projectile hits, then the X mark; the extra two stacks also require hitting a Stunned/Anomalous target.

reason.zh: 先把场上资源转成敌人身上的电囚，不能只看到电壶就开始连斩。
reason.en: Convert field resources into Electro Prison on the enemy before attempting enhanced slashes.

fallback.zh: 射空或目标换位就重新瞄准；没有壶先补壶。此基础轴不强制瞄准期间提前切人。
fallback.en: Re-aim after a miss or movement; replenish absent Quivers. This basic route does not require an early switch while aiming.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

title.en: Slash while the X mark remains

input.zh: 十文字出现后闪避接普攻；连续点按延续飞弦·斩，落羽后可按普攻快捷接入。
input.en: With an X mark, Dodge then Basic; keep tapping for Hiten no Tsuru slashes, or connect Basic directly after Falling Feather.

trigger.zh: 目标实际有至少2层电囚；若用落羽后直连，醒觉状态已经生效。
trigger.en: Target has at least two Electro Prison stacks; the Falling-Feather shortcut requires active Awakening.

complete.zh: 每次命中消耗2层；标记不足、失衡结束或需要防御时停下。
complete.en: Each hit consumes two stacks; stop when the mark runs out, Stun ends, or defense is needed.

reason.zh: 按资源决定次数；0影8层上限不代表每次必有4刀，1影也不能无条件写7刀。
reason.en: Counts follow resources: the M0 eight-stack cap does not guarantee four slashes, nor does M1 guarantee seven.

fallback.zh: 有标记但被打断可闪避接普攻恢复；标记消失先造壶/落羽，失衡结束交回青衣。
fallback.en: If interrupted with a mark, recover via Dodge–Basic. Without a mark, rebuild; after Stun, return to Qingyi.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

title.zh: 完成第五段，再检查产壶
title.en: Finish Basic 5 and check the new Quivers

input.zh: 连斩结束后继续普攻，确认转身射箭的第五段实际打出。
input.en: Continue Basics after the slashes and verify the turning fifth-stage shot actually occurs.

trigger.zh: 仍有输出窗口，且连携后的下一次第五段产壶机会尚未用过。
trigger.en: A damage window remains and the first Basic-5 generation after Chain has not been used.

complete.zh: 连携后的下一次第五段实际命中敌人，确认6壶；空挥或未命中敌人不保证6壶，常规第五段仅2壶。
complete.en: The first Basic 5 after Chain must actually hit the enemy for six Quivers. A whiff or ground hit does not guarantee six; an ordinary Basic 5 gives two.

reason.zh: 补壶方式取决于是否用过连携奖励，不把每轮第五段都算6壶。
reason.en: Generation depends on the unspent Chain bonus; not every Basic 5 supplies six.

fallback.zh: 没有连携奖励且EX已好，可改EX造壶；窗口已结束就回青衣，别为凑刀数贪招。
fallback.en: Without the Chain bonus, a ready EX can replenish Quivers. If the window ends, return to Qingyi.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

input.zh: 刚完成连携、EX或普攻第五段时长按特殊技；也可长按普攻瞄准后松开。

fallback.zh: 射空或目标换位就重新瞄准；没有壶先补壶。此基础轴不强制瞄准期间提前切人。
fallback.en: Re-aim after a miss or movement; replenish absent Quivers. This basic route does not require an early switch while aiming.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

title.en: Slash while the X mark remains

input.zh: 十文字出现后闪避接普攻；连续点按延续飞弦·斩，落羽后可按普攻快捷接入。
input.en: With an X mark, Dodge then Basic; keep tapping for Hiten no Tsuru slashes, or connect Basic directly after Falling Feather.

trigger.zh: 目标实际有至少2层电囚；若用落羽后直连，醒觉状态已经生效。
trigger.en: Target has at least two Electro Prison stacks; the Falling-Feather shortcut requires active Awakening.

complete.zh: 每次命中消耗2层；标记不足、失衡结束或需要防御时停下。
complete.en: Each hit consumes two stacks; stop when the mark runs out, Stun ends, or defense is needed.

reason.zh: 按资源决定次数；0影8层上限不代表每次必有4刀，1影也不能无条件写7刀。
reason.en: Counts follow resources: the M0 eight-stack cap does not guarantee four slashes, nor does M1 guarantee seven.

fallback.zh: 有标记但被打断可闪避接普攻恢复；标记消失先造壶/落羽，失衡结束交回青衣。
fallback.en: If interrupted with a mark, recover via Dodge–Basic. Without a mark, rebuild; after Stun, return to Qingyi.

label.zh: 嘉音仍以咏叹华彩驻场；加攻另看25能量与合格入场。
label.en: Astra remains on stage in Idyllic Cadenza; ATK requires 25 energy and a qualifying entry.

prep.zh: 已有连携/EX造壶就跳过第一步；青衣羁服、嘉音加攻按实际状态确认。
prep.en: Skip the first step if Chain/EX already created Quivers; verify actual Subjugation and Astra ATK.

prep.zh: 第二组不是必做；目标已恢复或资源不足时直接回击破准备。
prep.en: The second group is optional; return to setup if the enemy recovers or resources are insufficient.

text.zh: 1影电囚上限14、每壶发两矢；按实际命中与标记延长连斩，不保证固定刀数。
text.en: M1 raises the cap to 14 and fires two projectiles per Quiver; extend only for actual hits and marks.

text.zh: 2影连携或Q发动给7层电掣，每次飞弦·斩结束耗1层；电掣不是电囚，不能用它替代攻击门槛。
text.en: M2 grants seven Flash stacks on Chain/Ultimate use and spends one after each slash; Flash is not Electro Prison.

text.zh: 4影Q发动给场上敌人满电囚；自身Q已就绪时可走Q→标记连斩。0–3影Q没有这项造标记效果。
text.en: At M4, Ultimate applies maximum Electro Prison to field enemies, enabling a ready Ultimate → marked slashes branch. M0–3 do not gain this.

text.zh: 青衣1影进战满电压可跳过开局攒条；满电压发动长按且命中才取得该影画减防，不是每轮重新赠满。
text.en: Qingyi M1 starts with full Voltage; its DEF reduction needs a full-Voltage hold that hits, not a fresh gift every loop.

text.zh: 残心青囊的额外暴击率要求队伍任意角色实际施加异常或打入失衡；不改变电壶与电囚门槛。
text.en: Zanshin Herb Case’s extra CRIT needs any squad member to actually inflict Anomaly or Stun; resource gates remain.

text.zh: 玉壶青冰按普攻实际命中叠茶劲；取得层数时达到15层才触发全队增伤。
text.en: Ice-Jade Teapot stacks on actual Basic hits; the team buff requires gaining a stack with at least 15 stacks.

text.zh: 玲珑妆匣按实际消耗至少25能量叠全队增伤；开唱本身不算两层。
text.en: Elegant Vanity stacks team damage on an actual spend of at least 25 energy; singing does not grant two stacks.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.嘉音开唱，确认快支: 点按特殊技驻唱，等悠真提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.悠真快支接手: 看到悠真快支提示再接
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.青衣EX接第三段: 有能量时强化特殊技接普攻第三段
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.连点第三段，积累电压: 连点普攻第三段积电压
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.长按至终结一击命中: 闪络时长按普攻，等最后一击
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选：嘉音终结技提供转换连携: 可选：嘉音开终结技，等悠真提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.落羽激活电壶: 长按特殊技，或长按普攻瞄准后松开
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按十文字余量连斩: 看到十文字后，闪避接普攻连斩
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.完成第五段，再检查产壶: 点按普攻完成第五段，检查电壶

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按实际快支提示切悠真，完成穿弦。: 出现悠真的快速支援提示时，按对应支援键完成入场攻击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.实际连携提示可选悠真时确认；让箭命中敌人或地面。: 连携选项里有悠真时选他，让箭实际命中敌人或地面。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.刚完成连携、EX或普攻第五段时长按特殊技；也可长按普攻瞄准后松开。: 刚完成连携、强化特殊技或普攻第五段时，长按特殊技；也可长按普攻瞄准后松开。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.十文字出现后闪避接普攻；连续点按延续飞弦·斩，落羽后可按普攻快捷接入。: 看到「十文字」标记后，按闪避再按普攻起手，连点普攻续斩；刚用过瞄准射击时也可直接按普攻起手。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1201: 先看电壶与标记；没有快支衔接点时，可打普攻到第五段，再长按特殊技瞄准射击。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100005: 点按特殊技，等攻击命中并进入驻唱
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100012: 喧响到「极」且终结技就绪时点按终结技，等命中

120100001: 连斩后继续点普攻打到第五段；以转身射箭为准，不是切入后一律点五下。
Continue Basic after the slashes until hit 5, indicated by the turning arrow shot. Do not always count five new taps.
120100050: 有十文字才做此路线：闪避后点普攻起手，再点普攻续斩；落羽后的快捷入口可直接点普攻。
With the mark active, tap Basic after Dodge and repeat for the slashes. The Falling Feather shortcut lets you tap Basic directly.
125100001: 本步用普攻积闪络电压；进入第三段后持续点按维持连击，按当前连段衔接。
Build voltage with Basics. Once in hit 3, keep tapping Basic to sustain the string.
125100004: 闪络状态下长按普攻打突进终结；长按是发动键，不是先普攻若干下。
Hold Basic in Flash Connect for the advancing finisher. The hold activates it; no counted preliminary taps.
125100006: 本步若用强化特殊技，先放再点普攻直达第三段；已在第三段且只需维持连击时无需为接段重放。
If using EX, cast it first, then tap Basic to enter hit 3 directly. If already sustaining hit 3, EX is not needed to enter it again.
